thread:
julia: FYI planning an org-wide dry-run next Tue to validate our access-review detections + rollback paths. calling it 'access gremlin' so it's memorable. want to run at 09:00 PST and target small slice (5% svcaccts + 3 dev admins).

maya: +1. what's the exact failure mode? full role removal or just revoke session tokens?

julia: full role removal (remove AdminBinding) for the selected principals, but we'll keep a fast rebind path in the runbook. idea is to exercise audit logs, alerting, and owner attestation flows.

own: We should check KMS grants too — removing admin might break key rotation jobs. do we have a pre-check query?

samir: I wrote a quick query to find svcaccts with kms:grant + admin role:
```
SELECT principal, role, resource
FROM `infra_access.access_bindings`
WHERE role LIKE '%Admin%'
  AND resource LIKE '%cloudkms%'
LIMIT 200
```

maya: nice. can you tag owners? we need owner emails for the attestation form.

samir: will do. I also ran a smoke test against staging where I removed AdminBinding for a test svcacct — the rotation job failed with exit 3 but auto-requeued after 2m once we re-bound the role. logs: `rotation: ERR code=3 svc=key-rotator`

julia: good to know. runbook snippet for rollback: 1) escalate to oncall 2) run `rbac rebind --principals @list --role Admin` 3) confirm rotation job success in logs 4) mark attestation as forced pass.

kai: who will run the gremlin? I volunteer to coordinate the blast radius and hit the revert commands.

julia: thanks kai. can you own the rebind play and be available during the window?

kai: yes. I'll be on call and on Zoom. also adding a 15-minute pre-check at 08:45 to validate the selection script.

own: can we wire up an audit-log quick view? something like: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"' --limit 50` to watch removals.

maya: we'll add an ephemeral dashboard for the run — token/latency and error spikes + KMS rotation failures. I'll create it and share link.

access-bot: pre-flight checks passed: entitlement-scorer run completed; candidate list size = 123 principals; owner coverage = 92%; critical jobs linked = 7. See <https://redwood.app/infra/access/candidates/4367890123>

samir: owners missing ~8 principals — I'll ping Papercut for owner lookups. recommend excluding those from the first run.

julia: agree exclude until we have owners. keep blast at ~5%. also we need approval from Eng Leads — @owen can you confirm?

owen: ok from infra side. +1 for Tue 09:00 PST provided we have revert in <10m and Kai is on standby.

oncall: I'll be primary pager for the slot. please add me to the Zoom invite and set PagerDuty to surge for 30m after start.

maya: added Zoom + PD surge. invite -> <https://zoom.redwood.com/gremlin-dryrun-4367890123>

julia: last safety: double-confirm KMS binding checklists. Samir, can you paste the exact command to verify KMS key grants pre-run?

samir: sure:
```
# list key bindings for principal
gcloud kms keys list --location global --keyring prod-keys --filter "bindings.principal:serviceAccount:my-svc@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

julia: perfect. we'll require that output attached to the run doc before go.

maya: one more thing — runbook will include automated rollback if more than 15% of rotation jobs fail within 10m. Kai ok with that automated revert?

kai: yes, but let's have a manual confirm step before the revert executes (2-person). I'll be one; need a second approver. Owen?

own: can do. two-person confirm sounds good.

julia: approvals checklist: Eng Leads (Owen) ✅, Oncall ✅, Security (Julia) ✅, SRE (Maya) ✅. Need Product FYI. I'll ping @samir to send the FYI thread.

access-bot: FYI — run metadata recorded: run_id=gremlin-4367890123, planned_targets=123, planned_exclude=8, owner_coverage=92%

samir: raising a small vuln-triage note: if any service reports KMS access errors, classify as P1 until fixed. add postmortem template in the doc.

julia: good call. add me as PM for the postmortem.

maya: ok locking this in. Pre-check 08:45, run 09:00, revert window until 09:10, PD surge until 09:30. I'll drop the dashboard link in the run doc.

kai: I'll bring the rebind script and test it once more in staging tonight.

julia: thanks team. I'll post the run doc now and tag Eng Leads. please react with :thumbsup: if you reviewed and are available.

owen: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup:

maya: :thumbsup:

kai: :thumbsup:
